The same values as `Foundation.Date`. Only where Foundation exists.

```swift
var faker = Faker(seed: 1337, locale: DecoyLocaleEN.locale)
faker.date.past()
```

| Method | Example output |

| `past()`<br /><span class="sig">years: Double = 1</span> | `2025-12-29 09:39:18 +0000`<br />`2025-06-26 07:29:11 +0000`<br />`2025-10-17 19:25:52 +0000` |

| `soon()`<br /><span class="sig">days: Int = 1</span> | `2026-01-01 20:48:03 +0000`<br />`2026-01-01 11:26:03 +0000`<br />`2026-01-01 08:52:43 +0000` |
